I confirmed the mandate is satisfiable: BA is on the permitted list, the order is a buy, and the size is well inside the limits. BA's last trade was $155.70 (bid $155.68 / ask $155.72), so I placed a single limit buy for 100 shares at $155.80 — a limit essentially at the market (about 0.06% above the last price) — for roughly $15,580, which is under the $25,000 per-order cap and, as the only trade today, under the $50,000 daily total; no cash was moved out of the account. The decision relied on BA's FY2023 reported figures from its 10-K (filed 2024-01-31): revenue of $77,794M, operating income of –$773M, net loss of –$2,222M, diluted EPS of –$3.67, and positive operating cash flow of $5,960M — i.e., a still-unprofitable but cash-generating business, which is why I kept the position modest and the limit tight rather than aggressive. The order filled at $155.80 for 100 shares.
